results.title: Ranbir Kapoor's 'Ramayana' crosses $11 million in advance bookings ahead of theatrical release
results.description: Highlights Ramayana has generated approximately $11.03 million in advance bookings across India, including blocked seats. The film has sold around 2.77 million tickets across 907 cities ahead of its November 5 theatrical release. Overseas advance sales have reached $5.65 million, with North America accounting for the largest share. Ranbir Kapoor's Ramayana has generated more than $11 million in advance bookings across India ahead of its theatrical release on November 5, building significant box office momentum for Nitesh Tiwari's ambitious adaptation of the ancient Indian epic. According to industry reports, the film has recorded advance sales worth approximately $11.03 million, including blocked seats. Around 2.77 million tickets have been sold across 87,881 shows in 907 cities, reflecting strong demand ahead of its opening. The Hindi version is leading the advance bookings with approximately $9.01 million, followed by Telugu at $904,000 and Kannada at $829,000. The Tamil version has contributed around $235,000, while Malayalam bookings stand at approximately $58,000. Ramayana sees strong overseas advance bookings The film has also attracted considerable interest in international markets, with overseas advance sales reaching approximately $5.65 million. North America is leading the overseas bookings with around $4.24 million, while Australia and New Zealand have contributed approximately $606,500. The UK and Ireland have recorded around $468,700, followed by Germany at $176,700. The international response adds to the film's strong domestic pre-release performance, particularly among audiences interested in large-scale Indian theatrical productions. Ranbir Kapoor leads an ensemble cast Apart from Ranbir Kapoor, who portrays Lord Rama, the film features Yash as Ravana, Sai Pallavi as Sita and Ravi Dubey as Lakshman. The ensemble cast also includes Sunny Deol, Anupam Kher, Lara Dutta, Sheeba Chadha, Rakul Preet Singh, Vivek Oberoi, Kunal Kapoor and Arun Govil. Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, Ramayana features music by Oscar-winning composers Hans Zimmer and A. R. Rahman. With its release approaching, the film's advance bookings have raised expectations for its theatrical opening. However, its actual box office performance will become clearer once it begins screening in theaters.

results.title: Allu Arjun extends support to Ranbir Kapoor, Yash and team Ramayana ahead of November 5 release
results.description: As anticipation builds around Nitesh Tiwari’s Ramayana: Part 1 starring Ranbir Kapoor, Allu Arjun has extended his wishes to the team of the upcoming mythological epic. The Telugu superstar took to X (formerly Twitter) to express his support for the ambitious two-part adaptation, describing it as more than just a film and highlighting its cultural significance for Indian cinema. With Ramayana: Part 1 scheduled to arrive in theatres worldwide on November 5, ahead of the Diwali weekend, Allu Arjun shared a message urging audiences to come together in support of the project. He wrote, “My best wishes to the entire #Ramayana team. It’s not just a movie. It’s a representation of our culture and an attempt to raise the bar of Indian films. I wholeheartedly send my pure, positive wishes to the entire team for their divine attempt. Let’s all unite and come forward to support a pure attempt that carries our stories, our culture and our glory. Jai Sri Ram.” My best wishes to the entire #Ramayana team. It’s not just a movie. It’s a representation of our culture and an attempt to raise the bar of Indian films. I wholeheartedly send my pure, positive wishes to the entire team for their divine attempt. Let’s all unite and come forward to support a pure attempt that carries our stories, our culture and our glory. Jai Sri Ram 🙏🏽 The actor also tagged several members of the film’s ensemble cast and creative team, acknowledging the scale of the project and the people bringing the epic to the screen. The film features Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, with the actor also portraying sage-warrior Parashurama, while Yash takes on the role of Ravana. Sai Pallavi plays Goddess Sita, and Ravi Dubey portrays Lakshman. Sunny Deol essays Lord Hanuman, while Rakul Preet Singh appears as Surpanakha. The ensemble also includes Lara Dutta as Queen Kaikeyi, Kajal Aggarwal as Mandodari, Vivek Oberoi as Vidyutjihva and Anupam Kher has lent voice to Jatayu. Allu Arjun’s message extended beyond the cast, with the actor also acknowledging director Nitesh Tiwari and producer Namit Malhotra, whose Prime Focus Studios and DNEG are associated with the production. He also tagged composers Hans Zimmer and A.R. Rahman, who have collaborated on the film’s music. Mounted on a large scale, Ramayana: Part 1 is set for a worldwide theatrical release on November 5, 2026. The film will arrive in standard, IMAX and other premium formats, with releases planned across multiple Indian and international languages. Allu Arjun’s message adds to the anticipation surrounding the film, which brings together actors and creative talent from across the country for a cinematic adaptation of one of India's most enduring epics.

results.title: Ravi Kishan wraps up dubbing for Suryaa, set for November 20 release
results.description: The post-production work on Sunny Deol and Ravi Kishan’s upcoming film Suryaa is progressing, with the project reaching another milestone. Ravi Kishan has completed his dubbing for the film, bringing it a step closer to its scheduled theatrical release. The film brings Sunny Deol and Ravi Kishan together, with both actors known for their distinct screen presence and performances. Their coming together is one of the key aspects of Suryaa, which is currently in the final stages of preparation ahead of its release. Directed by M. Padmakumar, the film features an ensemble cast that includes Pragya Jaiswal, Jisshu Sengupta, Tinnu Anand, Manish Wadhwa and Tanushree Chakraborty, among others. The combination of an established cast and an intriguing premise forms the backdrop of the upcoming theatrical project. Ravi Kishan’s dubbing completion marks an important step in the film’s post-production process as the makers continue preparations for its release. The development also indicates that the film is moving closer to its scheduled arrival in cinemas. Suryaa is presented by Kamal Mukut and produced by Deepak Mukut, Hemmant Mukut and Lokesh Mukut under the banner of MM Moviez. The film is scheduled to release in theatres on November 20, 2026. With the post-production work progressing, the film is now heading towards its theatrical debut. Audiences will get to see Sunny Deol and Ravi Kishan share screen space when Suryaa arrives in cinemas later this month.
